question: Does the pretrained model change sensitivity to CEM iteration budget and the matched quality-latency frontier?
task_source: Completed Fast-LeWM reproduction 25569241.pbs101; unchanged 50 official seed-42 dataset rows

settings.scaler: dataset-wide StandardScaler fitted once to finite rows of action/proprio/state as official evaluator

run_order: Fixed before measurement. First two seed blocks reverse order; third fixed permutation. Not fully position-balanced.

validity.fast_seed42_i30_control: Check exact 49/50 outcome vector against completed reproduction. A discrepancy triggers interface diagnosis, no success-driven tuning.
validity.lewm_i30_quality_screen: At least 45/50 per seed to treat the matched LeWM baseline as usable; otherwise preserve result and diagnose changed backend before mechanistic claims.

analysis.independent_unit: 50 source tasks; three solver-seed repeats are nested, not 150 independent tasks
analysis.quality: Success counts by seed; paired task-wise 10-minus-30 differences and model-by-budget difference; report uncertainty, no equivalence claim from nonsignificance
analysis.latency: Fresh clones of the same initial observation, one warmup then three synchronized repeated native solves per arm. Actual load recorded. Report per-seed median and range, exclude initialization and preparation.
analysis.claim_boundary: Model/checkpoint comparison under a common compatible runtime. Different training and encoders prevent attributing differences solely to architecture. No cross-model latent-cost magnitude or teacher-fidelity interpretation.
analysis.rng_boundary: Same seeds pair experimental conditions, but budgets change native RNG consumption; no shared-candidate claim across later environments or replans.
analysis.no_expansion: No training, extra seeds, extra tasks, CEM hyperparameter search or follow-up experiment before this frozen campaign is complete. Any insight pilot requires a separate frozen bounded protocol.

quota_rule: Remaining primary Codex quota below 40 percent: finish current submitted experiments, summarize and pause expansion; never use a reset credit.
